chunks: If We had destroyed them by some calamity sooner than this, they would have surely said: 'O Lord, if You had sent to us a messenger we would have followed Your command before being humbled and disgraced.'
ai.seo_question: Why do disbelievers claim they would have followed God if a messenger had been sent earlier?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of *Tanzih* (divine justice), illustrating that punishment is not arbitrary but follows the clear establishment of *Hujjah* (proof) through a messenger. It highlights the psychological state of the disbelievers who, despite receiving signs, delayed acceptance until the moment of inevitable humiliation, thereby validating the necessity of divine guidance before accountability.
